findings.issue: An ordinary breaking space (U+0020) precedes « : ». The fr style guide requires the narrow no-break space U+202F before : ; ! ? in prose. The refusal band wraps, so a breaking space can push the colon to the start of the next line. The fr desktop corpus is mixed (401 ordinary spaces, 163 U+202F), which is why this is minor and not major.

findings.proposed: Impossible d’ignorer cette demande : rien n’a été envoyé.
findings.proposed_note: Only change: U+0020 → U+202F before the colon. Verified to parse and to be NFC.

findings.issue: Meaning is right: « Impossible d’ignorer cette demande » reuses « Ignorer » and « demande » (rounds 1/4), and « rien n’a été envoyé » states that nothing was sent. « Impossible de … » is the fr corpus pattern (57 uses). Apostrophes are U+2019. ask-panel.tsx joins this sentence and the owner's refusal sentence with join(" "), so a following sentence starts after one ASCII space. That is fine for all locales (zh-CN after 。 reads acceptably; ur sentence order stays logical under dir=rtl). Code-level, not a catalogue defect. Not counted.
